description: Land Title Settlement Department - Diulgahamula Watta, Kadulla Pottha, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420202
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner names, and property encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
